about: Golden corpus for runner/safety-hook-core.mjs: every tool call the hook suites feed to the hook,
deduplicated, with the verdict the core gave. Asserted by runner/test/safety-hook-golden-corpus.test.mjs;
inputs harvested by runner/test/lib/hook-corpus-harvest.mjs. Machine-written: refresh it only on purpose
(--update after an intended rule change), never by hand.
Entry: from = the suites that feed it; payload (the JSON the hook receives) or raw (exact stdin text when
it is not a JSON.stringify round trip); strings over 4096 chars are { $pieces: [text | { $repeat, times }] }.
verdicts.<profile> = { verdict: allow|deny, exit: 0|2, prefix: reason up to its first colon, reason, stdout? },
or "=<profile>" when it is the same as that earlier profile's.

environment.base: a fresh realpath'd scratch dir per run; {{BASE}} in a recorded reason

placeholders.{{FACTORY}}: the live checkout (dirname of runner/), so front-door cases name the real runner
placeholders.{{WORK}}: <base>/work: a git repo on main (src/a.js, README.md, .gitattributes committed; .env untracked); the write root and the cwd
placeholders.{{HOME}}: <base>/home (.ssh/id_rsa): HOME, at core load time too (the test re-runs itself with it)
placeholders.{{TMP}}: <base>/tmp: a suite scratch dir that is none of the above, by its prefix

environment.common: PATH inherited; HOME={{HOME}}; LC_ALL=C; GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; GAFFER_DATA={{DATA}}; GAFFER_TICKET=corpus; MCP_CONFIG; cwd={{WORK}}
environment.normalised: a suite's write roots, bootstrap dir and non-runner cwd -> {{WORK}}; read roots -> {{READ}}; GAFFER_DATA -> {{DATA}}; HOME -> {{HOME}}; other mkdtemp dirs -> {{TMP}}/<prefix>
